input.description: The inputs the command catalogue in the meta model lists for this command.

reason.description: Required when the catalogue says reason_required, and always for the overseer.

idempotency_key.description: The same key sent twice returns the first result and changes nothing more.

expected.description: Optional: the state the client saw. If the entity has moved on, the command is refused with stale_view and nothing changes.

dry_run.description: Validate and answer what would happen; change nothing; still audited as a dry run only when refused.
